Starting with brown

  1. ch2, 6 sc in 1st ch (6)

  2. [inc] around (12)

  1. ch2, 6 sc in 1st ch (6)

  2. [inc] around (12)

Stuff and attach safety eyes (I placed mine between rounds 11 and 12 at about 8 sts apart)

F/O, leave long tail for sewing

2 Ears

Starting with tan

  1. ch2, 6 sc in 1st ch (6)

  2. [sc, inc] around (9)

  3. [2 sc, inc] around (12)

Starting with brown

  1. ch 6, [sc] across, working on the opposite side of the chs: [sc] across (10)

F/O, leave long tail for sewing

Body

Starting with tan

First Haunch

  1. ch 2, 6 sc in 1st ch (6)

  2. [inc] around (12)

  3. [sc, inc] around (18)

F/O

Second Haunch

  1. sc into one of the sts in the first haunch, [sc] around the first haunch

  1. ch 2, 6 sc in 1st ch (6)

2 – 3. [sc] around (6)

  1. Fold in half and [sc] across the top (3)

2 Feet

  1. ch2, 6 sc in 1st ch (6)

  2. [2 sc, inc] around (8)

3 – 4. [sc] around (8) – Break off brown

5 – 6. Attach tan – [sc] around (8)

  1. [2 sc, dec] around (6)

Assembly

See pictures above if you need help with placement

▪ Sew the eye patch onto the head

▪ Sew the inner ears onto the ears

▪ Sew the ears onto the top of the head

▪ Take one ear and sew the tip of the ear onto the top of the inner ear

▪ Use pink yarn to embroider a nose onto the head

▪ Use crochet thread to embroider a mouth onto the head

▪ Sew the head onto the top of the body

▪ Sew the feet onto the bottom of the body

▪ Sew the arms on either side of the body

▪ Sew the tail onto the back of the body
